modules.name: Chord Caster
modules.description: A 6-note stereo phase-distortion synth voice with chord sequencer, parameter automation, modulation bus, tanh saturation and fractional three-tap delay.

modules.name: Poly Map
modules.description: Companion module to Chord Caster. Map poly inputs to a V/oct containing only the active notes, based on gates.

modules.name: Chordy
modules.description: The 6-note chord sequencer from Chord Caster in a compact form.
